about: Zero-Japanese topics: page is the extension's page guard (extension/src/levels.js isZeroJapanese, checked by extension/test/zero.test.js), chat the hook's guard for topical words (scripts/weave.py zero_japanese, checked by tests/test_weave.py). The page guard keeps one short list for a short passage; on chat its word families fire on the talk of code, so the chat guard counts those only in pairs.
